name: Camp Everstill
summary: Camp Everstill is a quiet Alliance encampment situated along the northern bank of Lake Everstill in the Redridge Mountains. Established near the waterline, it serves as a staging post and vantage point overlooking the contested lake.

sections.title: A Foothold on the Lake
sections.body: Perched on the northern shoreline of Lake Everstill, Camp Everstill provides travelers and Alliance forces with a direct vantage point over the water. While Redridge faces pressure from gnoll packs and Blackrock orc warbands descending from the heights, small camps like this offer essential rest and observation away from the crowded town center of Lakeshire.

faq.answer: Camp Everstill sits directly on the northern shore of Lake Everstill in the Redridge Mountains, just across the water from Lakeshire.
It is an Alliance encampment, offering a foothold and resting point for friendly travelers navigating the perimeter of the lake.

faq.q: Why is there an outpost here?
faq.answer: With Lake Everstill surrounded by encroaching gnoll tribes and hostile wildlife, maintaining camps along the lake's banks helps watch the water and secure the outskirts of Redridge.

angles.text: The camp offers a calm respite on Lake Everstill's edge while town guards in Lakeshire struggle to defend against Blackrock orcs and local gnolls.
